name: shared-clipboard-probe
description: Private owner-authenticated explicit text and selected UTF-8 file snapshots, plus literal Mac clipboard writes. Live provider, tunnel, Dots and OS verification is deferred.

interface.longDescription: Read explicitly shared immutable text and selected UTF-8 file snapshots with bounded pages and SHA-256 verification. Copy literal text to the Mac on request. No execution, automatic capture or remote file paths. Actual OAuth provider, tunnel, intended dot and OS clipboards remain unverified.
defaultPrompt: List context files and text I explicitly shared
Copy this literal text to my Mac clipboard
